# simulate random square matrix with same tail: scale so that median matches
R=np.linalg.svd(rng.standard_normal((384,384)),compute_uv=False)
# match on ranks 150..383 by least squares scale
sc=np.dot(s[150:],R[150:])/np.dot(R[150:],R[150:])
print('scale',sc)
print('observed',np.round(s[25:60],3))

# count observed above random max
print('n above random max:',(s>sc*R[0]).sum())
